{{Quote|While the bottles say Corellian Reserve, what they're pouring is Vasarian."<br />"I like Vasarian.|[[Usk Haffa]] and [[Dix Tarfait]], aboard the ''[[Salin Mariner]]''|<ref name="Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>}}
'''Vasarian brandy''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]] made from fruits and berries from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was popular on [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] worlds such as [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] enjoyed drinking from large mugs of [[Vasar system/Legends|Vasarian]] brandy while entertaining potential business associates. [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] was also fond of it.
